detail.longDescription: A 27B model on my own GPU audited my Splunk and Sysmon install with zero cloud: 10 real findings, and it fixed some of them itself, including two false positives from its own earlier audits. # ai # security # llm # devops # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community I let a local 27B LLM audit and fix my Splunk + Sysmon stack
